title: Laundry Appliance Brand Reliability: Consumer Reports
desc: Consumer Reports’ combined washer-and-dryer brand reliability ranking, based on member reports of products bought new in 2015–2025. This is not a washer-only ranking; CR says it averages reliability across the brand’s washer and dryer types.

source.name: Consumer Reports — Most Reliable Laundry Appliance Brands of 2026 (licensed reprint)
source.note: All 17 brands and displayed ranks (including the three-way rank 9 tie), chart label, sample years, and combined washer/dryer scope were checked against Consumer Reports’ 2026 licensed reprint by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-21. The reprint states current washer sample: 108,608 units bought new 2015–2025, within 204,923 combined washers and dryers. Brand reliability is averaged across laundry appliance categories; it does not represent cleaning performance. The original CR page is also linked for context.
